item.description: Hippphon #2687 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Hippphon #2687 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus)
item.description: Hippphon #2687 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
